senses.gloss: m. (= תלתלן, v. preced.) [curly plant,] fenugrec. [Asaph quoted in Löw Pfl., p. 316, has תלתל.] Mekh. Mishp., s. 13; a. e., v. גֵּרָה II.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 10:6">Ter. X, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 8:8">Tosef. ib. VIII, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:4">Ib. X, 4</cite> <he>ת׳ של תרומה וכ׳</he> a decoction of fenugrec seeds … with which a priest’s daughter has washed her hair (v. Löw Pfl., p. 317); a. fr.
